text: dsh-ths-holdings 是面向 DSH Web 和 Desktop 的同花顺投资账本插件，提供持仓盈亏悬浮卡片和组合报告 Skill。插件通过宿主 Web 路由读取同花顺投资账本数据，在卡片展示今日持仓盈亏、上证指数和分时图，并支持组合选择、Cookie 登录与自动刷新；Skill 可在聊天或定时任务中查询组合、完整持仓及盈亏。适合需要查看沪深股票和 ETF 组合表现、生成持仓摘要的投资者。需要同花顺账本账号并保存登录 Cookie；可通过 Edge/Chrome 登录获取，也可手动粘贴。

dsh-ths-holdings adds a Tonghuashun portfolio P&L card and report Skill to DSH Web and Desktop. The card shows holdings P&L, the Shanghai Composite and an intraday chart; the Skill queries portfolios, positions and P&L in chat or scheduled tasks. Requires a Tonghuashun account and login Cookie.

dsh-ths-holdings 的功能「card」：卡片展示今日持仓盈亏、上证指数和分时图，并可配置刷新和显示。
dsh-ths-holdings 的功能「portfolio」：插件查询账本组合列表，支持自动发现并选择组合。
dsh-ths-holdings 的功能「positions」：聊天查询工具返回组合完整持仓和资产数据。
dsh-ths-holdings 的功能「pnl」：聊天查询工具返回所选账本的整体分时盈亏。
dsh-ths-holdings 的功能「login」：设置面板可启动浏览器登录并保存 Cookie，也支持手动录入。
dsh-ths-holdings README · Introduction：

dsh-ths-holdings README · Introduction：A **Tonghuashun holdings plugin** providing a floating **position P&L card** and a **portfolio report Skill** for [DeepSeek Harness](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness) (DSH) Desktop and Web. It automatically syncs your **real portfolio data** from the [Tonghuashun investment-ledger](https://tzzb.10jqka.com.cn) (同花顺投资账本) — no manual stock picking. Displays **今日盈亏** (today's P&L), **上证指数** (Shanghai Composite Index), and an intraday mini chart, all in the A-share red-up/green-down convention.

dsh-ths-holdings README · Introduction：Unlike watchlist tools, this plugin reads your **actual positions** and shows your **real profit & loss** — both as a percentage and as a yuan amount — updating every 20 seconds.

dsh-ths-holdings README · Version compatibility：Plugin **0.3.2** targets the DSH **0.2 series** and has been tested with Desktop **0.2.0-rc.2**, without a compatibility exemption. For DSH 0.1, keep plugin **0.2.0**; this migration does not support the older host.

dsh-ths-holdings README · Version compatibility：**0.3.2** lets you enable the card and portfolio report Skill independently, sharing sign-in and portfolio selection. All card settings remain available; with only the Skill enabled, configure sign-in under **Settings → Tonghuashun holdings**. Fully quit and restart DSH after upgrading.

dsh-ths-holdings README · Desktop：1. Open DSH Desktop and select **Plugins** in the sidebar.
2. Select **Add plugin** and enter `dsh-ths-holdings` in the package field.
3. Confirm that you trust the plugin as prompted, then select **Install**.
4. When installation finishes, select **Enable now**. The floating card appears at the bottom-right corner. If a restart is requested, fully quit Desktop and reopen it.

dsh-ths-holdings README · Desktop：Desktop does not currently update plugins automatically. To upgrade an installed version, uninstall it from the Plugins page, then install the new version. See the [official DSH installation guide](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness/blob/master/packages/client/ui-plugin-manager/README.md#installing-a-bundle).

dsh-ths-holdings README · Web：Run in a terminal:

```sh
dsh plugin --profile web add dsh-ths-holdings
```

After installation, **restart `dsh web`** and refresh the DSH page. The floating card appears at the bottom-right corner.

Desktop and Web manage their plugins separately; use the installation method for the application you run.

dsh-ths-holdings README · Usage：The plugin details page provides two independent component switches:

- **Portfolio report Skill**: holdings queries in ordinary chat and scheduled reports.
- **Tonghuashun holdings plugin (card component)**: the floating card with P&L and index data.

dsh-ths-holdings README · Usage：Both share the saved sign-in and portfolio selection. Enable either or both. All existing **⚙ card settings remain available**. With only the Skill enabled, sign in and choose a portfolio under **Settings → Tonghuashun holdings → Sign-in and portfolio**.

**Recommended — auto-acquire:**

dsh-ths-holdings README · Usage：1. Open DSH Desktop or Web and click **⚙** on the card.
2. Click **🖥 自动获取 Cookie（推荐）** — a system browser window opens (Edge / Chrome — the first installed one wins).
3. Sign in to the Tonghuashun investment ledger in that window (QR code / account).
4. When the sign-in succeeds the window closes itself, the Cookie is saved automatically, and the card refreshes with your portfolio.
5. The plugin auto-discovers your portfolio — if you have several, pick one from the dropdown. Done.

dsh-ths-holdings README · Usage：Click **立即更新数据** in the expanded ⚙ settings to fetch P&L and the index immediately using the saved sign-in and selected portfolio. The button shows a loading state during the request; failures retain previous successful values and their original update time.

dsh-ths-holdings README · Usage：Open **Settings → Tonghuashun holdings** in DSH to change the refresh interval (default: 20000 ms, or 20 seconds) and card visibility. Click **Save** to apply changes immediately and retain them after restart. Hiding the card stops its automatic refresh without disabling the Skill. The **Tonghuashun holdings plugin** card component switch controls whether the card feature is loaded; chat queries and scheduled reports require the **Portfolio report Skill** component to be enabled.

dsh-ths-holdings README · Usage：1. Open [https://tzzb.10jqka.com.cn](https://tzzb.10jqka.com.cn) and log in.
2. **Click the browser's top-right menu → More tools → Developer tools** (`…` in Edge, `⋮` in Chrome). F12 may have no effect on this page; open the tools through the browser menu.
3. **Keep developer tools open**, select **Network**, then refresh the ledger page to record requests.
4. Select a page or ledger API request to **`tzzb.10jqka.com.cn`**. Under **Headers → Request Headers**, copy the complete **Cookie** value. Copy only the `name=value; name2=value2` portion, without the `Cookie:` prefix; do not copy a response's `Set-Cookie` header.
5. Return to DSH Desktop or Web — click **⚙**, paste the cookie into **STOCK_PNL_COOKIE** → **save**.
6. The card validates the saved cookie immediately — it shows **✓ valid** or **✗ invalid** (with the reason/hint).

dsh-ths-holdings README · Usage：If the page reports that developer tools are unsupported, first check whether Network has already recorded a ledger request with a Cookie header. If no usable Cookie is available, use auto-acquire above. Keep developer tools open while inspecting cookies manually.

The session cookie expires eventually — when it does, the card shows a **Token 已过期** banner; re-open ⚙ and click **auto-acquire** (or repeat manual steps 1–5) with a fresh cookie.

dsh-ths-holdings README · Usage：> 💡 After completing a new trade, re-upload your data from the investment-ledger **app** to the web version so your holdings stay consistent between the two.

dsh-ths-holdings README · Query holdings in chat：Installing the plugin and enabling the **Portfolio report Skill** component automatically makes the bundled `ths-portfolio-report` Skill available in ordinary chat and scheduled tasks. No separate Skill installation or MCP server is needed. Sign-in and portfolio selection use either the card settings or **Settings → Tonghuashun holdings → Sign-in and portfolio**; you do not need to find or enter a portfolio ID.

After signing in, simply say in DSH chat:

dsh-ths-holdings README · Query holdings in chat：> Show my holdings in Tonghuashun Investment Ledger.

The assistant uses the selected portfolio. If several are available and none is selected, choose by name when asked. You can also say “Show holdings from my ‘Long-term investments’ portfolio in Tonghuashun Investment Ledger.”

dsh-ths-holdings README · Query holdings in chat：Reports default to an asset overview, the full holdings table and the largest positions. They include security names and codes, quantities, cost and current prices, market values, portfolio weights, holding P&L and daily P&L. Query time and ledger upload time are shown separately; missing data is identified rather than treated as zero.

dsh-ths-holdings README · Schedule reports：For example, say:

> Every weekday at 4:30 p.m. Beijing time, check my holdings in Tonghuashun Investment Ledger and generate a holdings and P&L report. Keep this task linked to the currently selected portfolio.

You can also include relevant news:

> Every weekday at 9:00 a.m., check my holdings in Tonghuashun Investment Ledger and tell me about important news related to those holdings.

dsh-ths-holdings README · Schedule reports：Have the assistant confirm the portfolio name and next run time. Scheduled reports require a running DSH host with Schedule enabled. Weekday rules do not automatically exclude exchange holidays.

dsh-ths-holdings README · Features：- **📊 Real-time position P&L** — polls every 20 s (configurable) from your actual portfolio
- **¥ / % toggle** — show today's P&L as a yuan amount, a percentage, or both
- **📈 Intraday chart** — mini polyline with a zero axis, red-up/green-down
- **🇨🇳 Shanghai Composite Index** — displayed alongside your P&L
- **🔄 Auto-discovery** — `fund_key` is discovered from the portfolio list; multi-account selection via dropdown
- **🖥 Auto-acquire Cookie** — one click pops the Edge sign-in window; the cookie is saved automatically, no F12 needed
- **✓ Validate on save** — the stored cookie is checked against the ledger right after paste or auto-acquire
- **↕ Draggable** — drag the title bar vertically along the right edge (position persists in localStorage)
- **⚙ In-place settings** — paste Cookie and select portfolio from the card itself
- **🔒 Credential-safe** — the Cookie never leaves the host process

dsh-ths-holdings README · FAQ / Troubleshooting：| Symptom | Cause & fix |
|---|---|
| Card shows `请配置 Cookie` | `STOCK_PNL_COOKIE` is empty — click **auto-acquire** in the ⚙ panel, or paste manually. |
| Card shows `Token 已过期` | Re-acquire the cookie or copy the Cookie request header using the manual steps above. |
| F12 has no effect | Click the browser's top-right menu → More tools → Developer tools, then follow the manual steps. |
| Login page says developer tools are unsupported | Auto-acquire does not require developer tools. For manual acquisition, check already recorded ledger requests in Network; if no usable Cookie is available, use auto-acquire. |
| No portfolio in the dropdown | The account list needs a valid Cookie first; save the Cookie, then click ↻ to refresh. |
| Multiple portfolios | Select the one you want from the dropdown — the choice is saved as `STOCK_PNL_FUND_KEY`. |
| Cookie pasted with line breaks | The plugin strips whitespace on save, so wrapped lines are fine. |
| “稍后重试” or “数据暂时无法获取” | Wait and retry. The card may retain previous successful values; check the displayed update time. |
| The assistant cannot query holdings | Check that the **Portfolio repo

dsh-ths-holdings README · Known Limitations：- **Auto-acquire uses a system browser** — no Playwright installation is needed. Edge or Chrome must be installed and the host must have a visible desktop session; otherwise use manual paste.
- Reports currently support ordinary CNY portfolios holding Shanghai/Shenzhen stocks and ETFs. Margin accounts, short positions, B shares and other markets are outside the supported scope.
- Enter login information only in plugin settings, not in chat or scheduled prompts.
